## `nixpkgs-review` result Generated using [`nixpkgs-review-gha`](https://github.com/Defelo/nixpkgs-review-gha) Command: `nixpkgs-review pr 476861 -p nixosTests.easytier-modular` Commit: [`3be0efae74ba10a6b9a8928476cd6159a91e55b7`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/3be0efae74ba10a6b9a8928476cd6159a91e55b7) ([subsequent changes](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/compare/3be0efae74ba10a6b9a8928476cd6159a91e55b7..pull/476861/head)) Merge: [`5e46dcf0f629ec5904ef680f1b7e0e29be0f7139`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/5e46dcf0f629ec5904ef680f1b7e0e29be0f7139) Logs: https://github.com/Moraxyc/nixpkgs-review-gha/actions/runs/20694169445 --- ### `x86_64-linux`
:white_check_mark: 1 test built:
  • nixosTests.easytier-modular

I don't think it's a good idea to directly use sysctl in preStart, since it disrupts the existing module system. Perhaps we just let users who need kernel forwarding manually configure the sysctl options, as is done in other distributions.

- [x] Has a NixOS VM test
- [x] Has a `meta.maintainers` attribute
- [x] Systemd-specific definitions are behind `optionalAttrs (options ? systemd)` to promote portability.
- [x] `_class = "service"`
- [x] Modular services provided through `passthru.services` must override the default of the package option using `finalAttrs.finalPackage`
- [ ] Is the modular services infrastructure sufficient for this service? If one or more features are not covered, comment in https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/428084

> It seems there is no way to implement `sysctl` at the moment.

That is a bit out of scope for modular services. Those are intentionally smaller scope; they're not a replacement for system-wide configuration.

Service looks good. Thank you!

issue.body:
- **easytier: switch to finalAttrs**
- **easytier.services.default: init**
- **nixosTests.easytier-modular: init**

An attempt to create a modular service. Please let me know if there’s anything that needs fixing.

It seems there is no way to implement `sysctl` at the moment. Should we use `preStart` instead?
https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/8f8e97e5e8046dc3698fa73c7a6f9b5bfc6164fc/nixos/modules/services/networking/easytier.nix#L283-L286

review_comments.body: We should make hostname a proper option
Just an idea: should we then offer the option at all if it is insecure?
Should we not patch that in the package instead?
Since a modular service is designed to be importable, an additional enable option is no need.
I prefer keeping this to provide a clear doc for users to not use it.
Not sure, I'm not familiar with packaging `easytier`. @L-Trump Could you take a look at this?
